description: This file defines the ProductReviewDao interface for database access operations related to product reviews, including methods for retrieving reviews by customer, product, language, and customer-product combination.

classes.name: ProductReviewDao
classes.description: Interface extending SalesManagerEntityDao to provide data access methods for ProductReview entities.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews authored by a specific customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific product in a specified language.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a product review written by a specific customer for a specific product.
